Suggested times: Wed/Thu 9-11am PT or Thu 2-4pm PT. If those don't work, propose others.

Thanks,
Laura

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@stratonix.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Meeting notes: Stratonix intake call — SOC 2 / SIG mapping (Thu Jul 22)

Hi all — notes and action items from today's call (thanks everyone for the time).

Attendees: Laura Chen (Stratonix), J. Patel (Procurement, partially), Soojin Lee, Marissa Cole, Rishi Malhotra (Redwood)

Summary:
- Walked through Stratonix_SIG_v1 and identified ~48 rows applicable to our scope. Rough split: ~30 rows can be satisfied with SOC 2 report + control narrative; ~18 require artifact pulls (configs, logs, screenshots).
- Redwood to provide initial evidence drop by Mon Jul 26 with SOC 2 report, retention policy, IAM export, and encryption configuration statement.
- Agreed on artifact naming convention: redwood_stratonix_<control>_<YYYYMMDD>_v1.pdf (Marissa to upload template to Drive).
- Rishi will validate which infra artifacts are automated vs manual and provide a short runbook for manual screenshots.

Open questions / clarifications from Stratonix:
1) For data-at-rest encryption, will a configuration export from our key management service suffice? (Answer: yes; Rishi to include key IDs and rotation policy in the export).
2) For user access reviews, Stratonix asked for date-stamped evidence showing the last quarterly review; we will provide the review report and the ticket references.
3) CAIQ overlap: Stratonix will flag high-priority CAIQ rows later; for now focus on SIG rows mapped to SOC 2.

Action items (owner — due):
- Upload initial evidence bundle (SOC 2 PDF, retention policy, encryption config, IAM export) — Marissa / Rishi — due 2026-07-26
- Provide infra runbook for manual artifact capture (screenshots & steps) — Rishi — due 2026-07-27
- Share Drive folder with Stratonix and procurement with Viewer + Commenter permissions — Marissa — done (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-Shared-Redwood-Stratonix)
- Redwood to mark mapped SIG rows in a copy of Stratonix_SIG_v1 and return with notes — Soojin — due 2026-07-28

Attachments uploaded to Drive (pre-read + follow-ups): Redwood_Soc2_Report_Q2_2026.pdf, Redwood_Evidence_Checklist_v3.docx, Redwood_Network_Matrix_v1.xlsx

If anything is missing or you'd like a different owner for any item, say so and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachments referenced: Redwood_Soc2_Report_Q2_2026.pdf, Redwood_Evidence_Checklist_v3.docx]
